name: @requrv/remem
description: Decisional memory for AI agents — one entry (store), one exit (recall), with Qdrant, Neo4j and a file/knowledge index.
author: ReQurv

scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.build:js: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target node --sourcemap --external=@qdrant/js-client-rest --external=neo4j-driver --external=zod --external=@aws-sdk/client-s3 && bun build src/index.ts --outdir tmp-cjs --format cjs --target node --sourcemap --external=@qdrant/js-client-rest --external=neo4j-driver --external=zod --external=@aws-sdk/client-s3 && mv tmp-cjs/index.js dist/index.cjs && mv tmp-cjs/index.js.map dist/index.cjs.map && rm -rf tmp-cjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
